title: Because
subtitle: 「因為／由於／既然」，從核心因果連接詞到正式理由表達。
description: 「因為／由於／既然」，從核心因果連接詞到正式理由表達。

words.example: Since the roads were icy, the school opened late.
words.exampleZh: 因為路面結冰，學校延遲開放。

exercises.original: Because the roads were icy, the school opened late.
exercises.zh: 因為路面結冰，學校延遲開放。
exercises.upgrade: Since the roads were icy, the school opened late.

options.explanation: 完整原因從句，且把 icy roads 當作背景原因，很自然。
引出結果，不是原因從句。
變成假設條件，而原句原因已成立。
通常接結果，不適合放在此句首原因位置。
後面應接名詞片語，如 because of the icy roads。

exercises.original: We stayed indoors because the weather was getting worse.
exercises.zh: 因為天氣愈來愈差，我們留在室內。
exercises.upgrade: We stayed indoors since the weather was getting worse.

options.explanation: 會變成『雖然天氣變差』，意思不同。
在主句後自然補充原因。
需要獨立句或分號結構。

exercises.original: Because you already know the procedure, we can begin immediately.
exercises.zh: 既然你已知道程序，我們可以立即開始。
exercises.upgrade: Since you already know the procedure, we can begin immediately.

options.explanation: 應接結果，不是這個位置。
已知事實作為背景理由，尤其自然。
後面通常接名詞，不直接接 you already know...。
結果副詞，不是從屬連接詞。

words.example: As the weather was poor, the event was moved indoors.
words.exampleZh: 由於天氣欠佳，活動移到室內舉行。

exercises.original: Because the venue was too small, the event was moved.
exercises.zh: 由於場地太小，活動搬到其他地方。
exercises.upgrade: As the venue was too small, the event was moved.

options.explanation: 把 venue too small 作背景原因，書面語自然。
後面需名詞片語，例如 because of the small venue。
不適合此句首從句位置。

exercises.original: The shop closed early because there were no customers.
exercises.zh: 因為沒有顧客，店舖提早關門。
exercises.upgrade: The shop closed early as there were no customers.

options.explanation: 自然補充 no customers 這個原因。
後面應接名詞，如 due to low customer numbers。

exercises.original: Because everyone agreed, the proposal moved forward.
exercises.zh: 由於大家都同意，建議繼續推進。
exercises.upgrade: As everyone agreed, the proposal moved forward.

options.explanation: 意思變成『雖然大家同意』。
後面不能直接接 everyone agreed。

words.example: Given that time is limited, we should focus on the main issues.
words.exampleZh: 鑑於時間有限，我們應集中處理主要問題。

exercises.original: Because time is limited, we should focus on the main issues.
exercises.zh: 因為時間有限，我們應集中處理主要問題。
exercises.upgrade: Given that time is limited, we should focus on the main issues.

options.explanation: 把時間有限作為做決定時要考慮的已知事實。
後接名詞，不接完整子句。

exercises.original: The price seems reasonable because the package includes support.
exercises.zh: 考慮到方案包括支援服務，這個價格看來合理。
exercises.upgrade: The price seems reasonable given that the package includes support.

options.explanation: 也可，但較口語；本題評價價格時 given that 更自然。
把 included support 作評價價格的考慮因素。

exercises.original: Because this is our first attempt, the result is encouraging.
exercises.zh: 鑑於這是第一次嘗試，結果令人鼓舞。
exercises.upgrade: Given that this is our first attempt, the result is encouraging.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 given that 更突出『考慮到這個條件』後的評價。
first attempt 是評價結果時的重要背景。

words.example: The event was postponed owing to the fact that the venue was unavailable.
words.exampleZh: 由於場地未能提供，活動延期。

exercises.original: The event was postponed because the venue was unavailable.
exercises.zh: 由於場地未能提供，活動延期。
exercises.upgrade: The event was postponed owing to the fact that the venue was unavailable.

options.explanation: 單獨 owing to 後應接名詞，如 owing to venue unavailability。
可正式接完整子句 the venue was unavailable。

exercises.original: Production stopped because no staff were available.
exercises.zh: 由於沒有員工可工作，生產停止。
exercises.upgrade: Production stopped owing to the fact that no staff were available.

options.explanation: 後面需名詞片語，例如 because of staff shortages。
正式因果表達，完整子句合法。

exercises.original: The report was delayed because the data were incomplete.
exercises.zh: 因為資料不完整，報告延遲。
exercises.upgrade: The report was delayed owing to the fact that the data were incomplete.

options.explanation: 單獨 due to 後通常接名詞，如 due to incomplete data。

words.example: Production slowed due to the fact that several machines were offline.
words.exampleZh: 由於數部機器停機，生產速度放慢。

exercises.original: Production slowed because several machines were offline.
exercises.zh: 由於數部機器停機，生產速度放慢。
exercises.upgrade: Production slowed due to the fact that several machines were offline.

options.explanation: 正式地接完整原因子句。
若後接名詞才自然，例如 due to machine failures。

exercises.original: The meeting ended early because two speakers were absent.
exercises.zh: 因兩名講者缺席，會議提早結束。
exercises.upgrade: The meeting ended early due to the fact that two speakers were absent.

options.explanation: 後面需名詞，如 because of two absences。

exercises.original: Sales fell because demand weakened.
exercises.zh: 由於需求轉弱，銷售下降。
exercises.upgrade: Sales fell due to the fact that demand weakened.

options.explanation: 後接名詞，如 owing to weaker demand。
可接 demand weakened 完整子句。

words.example: The result was impressive considering that the team had little preparation time.
words.exampleZh: 考慮到團隊準備時間很少，這個結果很出色。

exercises.original: The result was impressive because the team had little preparation time.
exercises.zh: 考慮到團隊準備時間很少，這個結果很出色。
exercises.upgrade: The result was impressive considering that the team had little preparation time.

options.explanation: 原因是評價 impressive 時的背景條件。

exercises.original: She did well because it was her first presentation.
exercises.zh: 考慮到這是她第一次簡報，她表現很好。
exercises.upgrade: She did well considering that it was her first presentation.

options.explanation: 也可，但 considering that 更強調評價背景。
first presentation 是衡量表現時的重要條件。

exercises.original: The price is low because the product is still new to the market.
exercises.zh: 考慮到產品仍是市場新產品，價格算低。
exercises.upgrade: The price is low considering that the product is still new to the market.

options.explanation: 用於評價價格時很自然。

words.example: Seeing that everyone agrees, we can move to the next item.
words.exampleZh: 既然大家都同意，我們可以進入下一項。

exercises.original: Because everyone agrees, we can move to the next item.
exercises.zh: 既然大家都同意，我們可以進入下一項。
exercises.upgrade: Seeing that everyone agrees, we can move to the next item.

options.explanation: 把 everyone agrees 當作顯而易見的既定理由。

exercises.original: We may as well leave because the shop is closed.
exercises.zh: 既然店舖已關門，我們不如離開。
exercises.upgrade: We may as well leave seeing that the shop is closed.

options.explanation: shop is closed 是眼前已知理由。

exercises.original: Because no one objected, the chair approved the change.
exercises.zh: 既然沒有人反對，主席批准了改動。
exercises.upgrade: Seeing that no one objected, the chair approved the change.

options.explanation: no one objected 是可直接推導決定的已知事實。

words.word: In view of the fact that
words.example: In view of the fact that demand has fallen, the company will revise its forecast.
words.exampleZh: 鑑於需求下降，公司將修訂預測。

exercises.original: Because demand has fallen, the company will revise its forecast.
exercises.zh: 鑑於需求下降，公司將修訂預測。
exercises.upgrade: In view of the fact that demand has fallen, the company will revise its forecast.
exercises.answer: in view of the fact that

options.text: in view of the fact that
options.explanation: 正式地把 demand fall 作為決策考量。
後面需名詞，如 because of falling demand。

exercises.original: The policy will be reviewed because conditions have changed.
exercises.zh: 鑑於情況已改變，政策將被檢討。
exercises.upgrade: The policy will be reviewed in view of the fact that conditions have changed.
exercises.answer: in view of the fact that

options.text: in view of the fact that

exercises.original: The committee postponed the decision because the evidence was incomplete.
exercises.zh: 委員會鑑於證據不完整而延遲決定。
exercises.upgrade: The committee postponed the decision in view of the fact that the evidence was incomplete.
exercises.answer: in view of the fact that

options.explanation: 若用應說 because of incomplete evidence。

options.text: in view of the fact that
options.explanation: evidence incomplete 是正式考量理由。

words.example: The application was rejected on the grounds that key documents were missing.
words.exampleZh: 申請因欠缺重要文件而被拒絕。

exercises.original: The application was rejected because key documents were missing.
exercises.zh: 申請因欠缺重要文件而被拒絕。
exercises.upgrade: The application was rejected on the grounds that key documents were missing.

options.explanation: rejected + stated formal reason 是典型搭配。
若接名詞可用，但不能直接接 key documents were missing。

exercises.original: The claim was dismissed because it lacked supporting evidence.
exercises.zh: 申索因缺乏支持證據而被駁回。
exercises.upgrade: The claim was dismissed on the grounds that it lacked supporting evidence.

options.explanation: 後面應接名詞，如 due to a lack of evidence。
dismiss a claim + formal reason 很自然。

exercises.original: The request was refused because the deadline had passed.
exercises.zh: 申請因截止日期已過而被拒絕。
exercises.upgrade: The request was refused on the grounds that the deadline had passed.

words.example: We decided to leave, for the weather was getting worse.
words.exampleZh: 我們決定離開，因為天氣愈來愈差。

exercises.original: We decided to leave because the weather was getting worse.
exercises.zh: 我們決定離開，因為天氣愈來愈差。
exercises.upgrade: We decided to leave, for the weather was getting worse.

options.explanation: 置於主句後補充解釋原因，書面語自然。

exercises.original: She stayed at home because she was feeling unwell.
exercises.zh: 她留在家中，因為身體不適。
exercises.upgrade: She stayed at home, for she was feeling unwell.

exercises.original: He accepted the explanation because the evidence was clear.
exercises.zh: 他接受了解釋，因為證據很清楚。
exercises.upgrade: He accepted the explanation, for the evidence was clear.

options.explanation: 也可，但本題目標是句後書面連接詞 for。
用獨立子句補充原因，標點和語域合適。

words.word: In light of the fact that
words.example: In light of the fact that costs have risen, the budget will be reviewed.
words.exampleZh: 鑑於成本上升，預算將重新檢討。

exercises.original: Because costs have risen, the budget will be reviewed.
exercises.zh: 鑑於成本上升，預算將重新檢討。
exercises.upgrade: In light of the fact that costs have risen, the budget will be reviewed.
exercises.answer: in light of the fact that

options.text: in light of the fact that
options.explanation: 新情況導致重新檢討，正式語域自然。
後接名詞，如 because of rising costs。

exercises.original: The schedule was changed because the deadline moved.
exercises.zh: 因截止日期改動，時間表亦作調整。
exercises.upgrade: The schedule was changed in light of the fact that the deadline moved.
exercises.answer: in light of the fact that

options.text: in light of the fact that
options.explanation: 新資訊引起調整，很貼切。

exercises.original: The recommendation was revised because new evidence emerged.
exercises.zh: 因出現新證據，建議被修訂。
exercises.upgrade: The recommendation was revised in light of the fact that new evidence emerged.
exercises.answer: in light of the fact that

options.text: in light of the fact that
options.explanation: revised after new evidence 是典型正式考量語境。

words.example: Seeing as it's raining, we may as well stay indoors.
words.exampleZh: 既然下雨，我們不如留在室內。

exercises.original: Because it's raining, we may as well stay indoors.
exercises.zh: 既然下雨，我們不如留在室內。
exercises.upgrade: Seeing as it's raining, we may as well stay indoors.

options.explanation: 很口語地表示『既然如此』。
天氣在原句已是事實，不是假設。

exercises.original: We should start now because everyone is here.
exercises.zh: 既然大家都到了，我們應該現在開始。
exercises.upgrade: We should start now seeing as everyone is here.

options.explanation: everyone is here 是眼前已知理由。

exercises.original: Because the shop is closed, let's come back tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 既然店舖已關門，我們明天再來。
exercises.upgrade: Seeing as the shop is closed, let's come back tomorrow.

options.explanation: 非正式、實際情況推論很自然。

words.example: We should leave early, especially since the roads may be busy.
words.exampleZh: 我們應該早點離開，尤其因為道路可能繁忙。

exercises.original: We should leave early because the roads may be busy.
exercises.zh: 我們應該早點離開，尤其因為道路可能繁忙。
exercises.upgrade: We should leave early, especially since the roads may be busy.

options.explanation: 把 roads may be busy 標記為特別重要的理由。

exercises.original: The proposal deserves attention because costs are rising quickly.
exercises.zh: 這項建議值得關注，尤其因為成本正快速上升。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal deserves attention, especially since costs are rising quickly.

options.explanation: 也可，但沒有『尤其』的強調。
強調成本上升是特別重要的支持理由。

exercises.original: We need a backup plan because no alternative supplier has been confirmed.
exercises.zh: 我們需要後備方案，尤其因為尚未確認其他供應商。
exercises.upgrade: We need a backup plan, especially since no alternative supplier has been confirmed.

options.explanation: 把未確認供應商作額外加強理由。

words.example: The meeting was shortened, the reason being that several speakers were absent.
words.exampleZh: 會議縮短了，原因是幾名講者缺席。

exercises.original: The meeting was shortened because several speakers were absent.
exercises.zh: 會議縮短了，原因是幾名講者缺席。
exercises.upgrade: The meeting was shortened, the reason being that several speakers were absent.

options.explanation: 補充解釋前面陳述的原因，句法自然。

exercises.original: The launch was delayed because the software was not ready.
exercises.zh: 發布延期，原因是軟件尚未準備好。
exercises.upgrade: The launch was delayed, the reason being that the software was not ready.

options.explanation: 後面需名詞，如 because of software problems。
很自然地補充 delayed 的理由。

exercises.original: The trip was cancelled because the weather had become unsafe.
exercises.zh: 行程取消，原因是天氣已變得不安全。
exercises.upgrade: The trip was cancelled, the reason being that the weather had become unsafe.

falseSynonyms.zh: because of 後接名詞，不是完整從句 because 後接完整子句；because of 後接名詞、代名詞或名詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Because it rained, we stayed inside. Because of the rain, we stayed inside.

falseSynonyms.zh: due to 通常後接名詞片語 due to 本身不是 because 的完全句法替代；若後接完整子句，通常要用 due to the fact that。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The delay was due to heavy traffic; we were late because traffic was heavy.

falseSynonyms.zh: owing to 通常後接名詞片語 owing to + noun；若要接完整子句，可用 owing to the fact that。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The match was cancelled owing to rain.

falseSynonyms.zh: 因此是結果，不是原因從句連接詞 therefore 引出結果；because 引出原因，邏輯方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was raining; therefore, we stayed inside. We stayed inside because it was raining.

falseSynonyms.zh: 所以引出結果，不是原因 so 通常把原因放前、結果放後；because 則引出原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It was late, so we left. We left because it was late.

falseSynonyms.zh: 雖然表示讓步，不是因果 although 表示『儘管』；不能代替 because。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Although it was raining, we went out.

falseSynonyms.zh: 如果表示條件，不是原因 if 引出條件；because 引出已成立的原因。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON If it rains, we will stay inside.

falseSynonyms.zh: while 通常表示同時或對比 while 可表示時間或對比；一般不能當作 because 的直接替代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON While I understand your point, I disagree.
